summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K on August 12, 2026, reporting an amendment and restatement of its senior secured multi-currency revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent. Changes include extending maturity to August 2031, increasing facility capacity from $3.828B to $3.990B, removing credit spread adjustments on dollar borrowings, and raising an accordion provision. Borrowings remain subject to a borrowing base and leverage restrictions under the Investment Company Act. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
